title: Geekvape Digi Pro Pod Vape Kit
description: The GeekVape Digi Pro Pod Kit is a sleek and user-friendly pod vape that delivers exceptional performance in a lightweight, portable design. Featuring a built-in 2000mAh battery and a maximum output of 40W, the Digi Pro offers a versatile and satisfying vaping experience for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) styles. The device is equipped with a 0.96” interactive screen, providing clear visibility and intuitive controls for easy navigation of settings and modes. An adjustable RGB pixel light adds a subtle yet customisable aesthetic flair. Refilling the Digi Pro is simple and mess-free thanks to its top-fill design, while adjustable top airflow ensures a smooth, leak-resistant vaping experience. Compatible with GeekVape’s full range of J series pods and coils, the kit includes two J Pod Cartridges with integrated coils (0.4ohm and 0.6ohm), ideal for use with 50/50 freebase or nic salt e-liquids. The Digi Pro also features both auto-draw and button activation, offering flexibility to suit your preferred vaping style. With smart mode functionality, A-lock safety, and Type-C fast charging, the Digi Pro is designed to cater to the needs of vapers at all levels of experience. Available in a variety of stylish colours, the GeekVape Digi Pro Pod Kit delivers modern vaping convenience, style, and performance in a compact, easy-to-use package. We recommend using High VG ( Sub-Ohm) E-liquid with the 0.4ohm DTL pod only and Nic Salts , 50/50 E-liquid with the 0.6ohm MTL pod. Browse our vape juice and choose the ideal match for this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
